---
title: "Simulate the SE2I2R model with covariate in Central America"
author: "Laura Andrea Barrrero Guevara"
date: "1/27/2022"
output: html_document
---
################################################################################
Purpose of script: Run simulations for SE2I2R model (Central America)
Output:
- {clim_name}_simulations_{i}_R0{R0_val}.Rds (simulations for every mun)
-  all_traj_hum_spe_R010 (all simulations)
################################################################################

# Setup
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("04_00_pck.R")
source("fun_createSE2I2Rmod_climcovars.R")
source("fun_reformatsimulations.R")
source("fun_eeunforcedmodel.R")
source("fun_set_cores.R")
source("fun_traj_mod_simulations.R")
dirs$out_sav <- glue("{dirs$outputs}/camerica_climcovars")
```

# Read in country and municipality names and df_covars 
```{r}
dat_mun <- unique(readRDS(
  glue("{dirs$processed}/data_clim_sel_week_narr_cam.rds"))$mun_city_name)
dat_mun_country <- readRDS(
  glue("{dirs$processed}/data_clim_sel_week_narr_cam.rds")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(country, mun_city_name) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(country = case_when(country == "Panamá" ~ "Panama",
                             TRUE ~ country))
df_covars <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$out_sav}/df_covars.rds")) %>%
  mutate(country = case_when(country == "Panamá" ~ "Panama",
                             TRUE ~ country)) %>%
  select(-mun_name) %>%
  rename(mun_name = mun_city_name)
```

# Run simulations (R0 = 10) for specific humidity 
```{r}
parallel::clusterExport(cl = my.cluster, varlist = c("dirs", "dat_mun", "df_covars"))
all_traj_hum_spe_R010 <- list(
  foreach(i = dat_mun, 
          .packages = c("glue", "pomp", "stringr", "tidyverse")) %dopar% {
    clim_name <- "w_hum_spe"
    R0_val <- 10
    bake(file = glue("{dirs$out_sav}/{clim_name}_simulations_{i}_R0{R0_val}.Rds"),{
      mod <- fun_traj_mod_simulations(
              clim_name = clim_name,
              amp_vec = c(-0.08, -0.06, -0.04, -0.03, 0, 0.04, 0.06),
              R0_val = R0_val,
              n_years = 200,
              delta_t = 0.1,
              amp_term = 0.25,
              mun = i,
              country_name = dat_mun_country[dat_mun_country$mun_city_name == i,"country"][[1]])
    })
  }
)
all_traj_hum_spe_R010 <- bind_rows(unlist(all_traj_hum_spe_R010, recursive = F))
```

# Plot last 10 years 
```{r}
pl_sim_10y <- list()
for (i in unique(df_covars$country)) {
pl_sim_10y[i] <- list(all_traj_hum_spe_R010 %>%
  filter(state_var == "I") %>%
  left_join(distinct(df_covars[,c("mun_name","country","mun_latitude")])) %>%
  filter(country == i) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time / 52, y = val, color = factor(amp_clim))) + 
    geom_line() + 
    labs(x = "Time (years)", y = "Proportion") + 
    facet_wrap(mun_name~., ncol = 5) + 
    scale_colour_viridis_d(expression(A[2]), end = 0.8, 
                           guide = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) + 
    theme_classic() + 
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          legend.justification = "right",
          strip.background = element_rect(color = "transparent")))
}
pl_sim_10y
```

# Plot last year
```{r, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
pl_sim_1y <- list()
for (i in unique(df_covars$country)) {
  pl_sim_1y[i] <- list(all_traj_hum_spe_R010 %>%
    filter(year == max(year), state_var == "CC") %>% 
    group_by(mun_name) %>% 
    mutate(val_scaled_mean = val / mean(val)) %>% 
    left_join(distinct(df_covars[,c("mun_name","country","mun_latitude")])) %>%
    filter(country == i) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = week, y = val_scaled_mean, color = factor(amp_clim))) + 
      geom_line() + 
      scale_y_continuous("Rescaled incidence") + 
      scale_x_continuous("Week no", breaks = c(20,40)) + 
      facet_wrap(reorder(mun_name, -mun_latitude)~., ncol = 5) + 
      scale_colour_viridis_d(expression(A[2]), end = 0.8, 
                           guide = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) + 
      theme_classic() + 
      theme(legend.position = "top",
          legend.justification = "right",
          strip.background = element_rect(color = "transparent")))
}
pl_sim_1y
```

```{r}
saveRDS(all_traj_hum_spe_R010, 
        glue("{dirs$out_sav}/w_hum_spe_simulations_all_R010.Rds"))
```
